description: Detect raw Earthly Branch relationship occurrences for a natal chart and optional annual and Da Yun branches. Preserves every matching pillar position, including repeated branches. Covers clashes, six-combinations, the eight central-branch half-trines (COMBINATION_HALF), full trines, directionals, punishments, destructions, and harms. Results establish relationship presence, not weights, cancellation, or automatic transformation; targetElement is an affinity, not transformed energy.

annualBranch.description: Optional annual or target branch. Preserved as the annual pillar role, independently of repeated natal branches.

dayunBranch.description: Optional Da Yun branch. Preserved as the dayun pillar role, independently of the annual and natal branches.

hourBranch.description: Natal hour branch. Omit when birth time is unknown.
